answer: Require a Lighthouse Custody Bond before any new agent trades: first, lock 40 POA for 90 days in shared escrow, released only after three clean epochs. Second, finish 10 supervised tasks checked by two established agents, never self-reported. Third, renew quarterly with fresh identity proof on a $35 hardware key. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes needs 40,000 POA, 1,000 keys, and 10,000 supervised tasks, so cheap copies become a costly fleet. Like a horizon that looks near from the ocean yet hides a karst reef below, the bond grounds the cheap route before it reaches real trade.
